items.quote: You're not a salesperson. You're a lead hunter.
items.statement: Your job isn't to sell. It's to hunt.

items.quote: Every morning you wake up with zero leads unless you create them yourself.
items.statement: Lead generation is 80% of the work.

items.quote: That's the biggest lie in the industry.
items.statement: Companies won't give you enough leads. Ever.

items.quote: Even the best companies can't generate enough quality leads to feed their entire sales force.
items.statement: You're competing with every other agent in your office for scraps.

items.quote: The sooner you accept that reality, the faster you'll start making real money.
items.statement: Stop waiting for leads to be given to you. Start building your own pipeline from day one.

items.quote: Practical result: Agents who focus on lead generation from week one earn 3x more.
items.statement: Agents who focus on lead generation from week one earn 3x more than those who wait for company leads.

overview: LinkedIn post sharing insights on starting a career in Dubai real estate.
